source.title: A Greek-English Lexicon (LSJ)
source.authors: Henry George Liddell and Robert Scott; revised by Henry Stuart Jones with Roderick McKenzie
source.credit: Text provided under a CC BY-SA license by Perseus Digital Library, http://www.perseus.tufts.edu, with funding from The National Endowment for the Humanities.
source.adaptation: Selected major-sense glosses extracted from the 1940 text; markup removed and Beta Code converted to Unicode. These are dictionary senses, not contextual translations.

morphology.note: Rule-based candidate analyses; no contextual disambiguation. Main forms retain accents. Separate fallbackForms ignore accents and case and must be labelled as such.

stats.scope: All keyed LSJ source entries and separately reviewed unkeyed subentries; selected senses, not complete articles.
